paite: Judah kumpipa Jotham, Ahaz leh Hezekiah vaihawm lai a Moreseth mi Mikah kiang a TOUPA thu hong tung, Samaria khua leh Jerusalem kho tungtang amuh thu.
english: The word of Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. that came to Micah the Morashtite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

paite: Nou, mite aw, na vek un za unla; Aw lei leh asung a om tengteng aw, ngaikhia un; Toupa PATHIAN, Toupa atempul siangthou a kipan, nou dem in na tungthu uh theihpihpa hi hen.
heading: Israel Leh Judah Dem A Thugenna
english: Hear, you peoples, all of you. Listen, O earth, and all that is therein: and let the Lord The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” Yahweh be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.

paite: Ngai dih ua, TOUPA amun a kipan in ahong pawt a, ahong paisuk ding a, lei mun sangte achil ngal ding hi.
english: For, behold, Yahweh comes forth out of his place, and will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.

paite: Mei kiangchin a khuainun bang leh munken a tui kikhohkhia bang mai in, tangte anuai ah azul ding a, munzangte akhangkham ding.
english: The mountains melt under him, and the valleys split apart, like wax before the fire, like waters that are poured down a steep place.

paite: Hiai tengteng Jakobte tatlekna ziak leh Israel inkote khelhna ziak ahi. Jakobte tatlekna bang ahia oi? Samaria ahi kei maw? Judah mun sangte bang ahia? Jerusalem ahi kei maw?
english: “All this is for the disobedience of Jacob, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the disobedience of Jacob? Isn’t it Samaria? And what are the high places of Judah? Aren’t they Jerusalem?

paite: Huaiziak in Samaria gam a thil sia omkhawm bang in ka bawl ding a, grephuan mun bang mai in; huai mun a suangte lui phaizang ah ka khukkhe ding a, asuangphumte ka dawksak ding hi.
english: Therefore I will make Samaria like a rubble heap of the field, like places for planting vineyards; and I will pour down its stones into the valley, and I will uncover its foundations.

paite: Amilim bawltawm tengteng sukkhap vek ahi ding a, akizuakna mante mei a halmang ahi ding a, amilim tengteng ka hihgawp ding; kizuakna man ding in ala vek ngal a, kizuakna man mah in apang nawn ding uhi.
english: All her idols will be beaten to pieces, and all her temple gifts will be burned with fire, and all her images I will destroy; for of the hire of a prostitute has she gathered them, and to the hire of a prostitute shall they return.”

paite: Hiai ziak in ka kap ding a, ka mau tuaituai ding a, kisuah leh vuaktang in ka om ding; sehalte bang in ka kikou ding a, vangawngsaute bang in ka thum ding hi.
english: For this I will lament and wail; I will go stripped and naked; I will howl like the jackals, and moan like the daughters of owls.

paite: Aliamna hihdam theih ahi kei; Judah gam atungta ngal a; ka mite kongpi, Jerusalem hial atungta hi.
english: For her wounds are incurable; for it has come even to Judah. It reaches to the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.

paite: Gath ah gen kei unla kap het kei un; Beth-le-aphrah ah leivui lak ah kikhuk un.
heading: Israel Siatna
english: Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t weep at all. At Beth Ophrah Beth Ophrah means literally “House of Dust.” I have rolled myself in the dust.

paite: Aw Saphir mi, vuaktang leh zumtak in paimang in; Zaanan mite Beth-ezel kahna ziak in ahong pawtkhe kei ding ua; huai a bitna mun a-om louh ziak in.
english: Pass on, inhabitant of Shaphir, in nakedness and shame. The inhabitant of Zaanan won’t come out. The wailing of Beth Ezel will take from you his protection.

paite: Maroth mi in tanhoih tan angaklah tuntun hi; TOUPA kiang a kipan thil hoih lou Jerusalem kongpi tan a ahong tunsuk ziak in.
english: For the inhabitant of Maroth waits anxiously for good, because evil has come down from Yahweh to the gate of Jerusalem.

paite: Aw Lakish mi, kangtalai sakol hattak henden in; amah pen Zion tanu khelhna kipatna ahi. Israelte tatlekna nang a muh ahi.
english: Harness the chariot to the swift steed, inhabitant of Lachish. She was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion; For the transgressions of Israel were found in you.

paite: Huaiziak in Moreseth-gath kiang ah kikhakna thilpiak na piak ding ahi; Akzib innte Israel gam kumpipate a ding in khemna ahi ding hi.
english: Therefore you will give a parting gift to Moresheth Gath. The houses of Achzib will be a deceitful thing to the kings of Israel.

paite: Aw Maresa mi, nang hon zoutu na kiang ah ka hon pi ding; Israelte thupina Adullam pha in ahong pai ding hi.
english: I will yet bring to you, inhabitant of Mareshah. He who is the glory of Israel will come to Adullam.

paite: Kimetgiau inla, na ta deihtakte ziak in kimetgiau in; musane bang in kihihgiau semsem in; na kiang a kipan sal a pi in a-omta uhi.
english: Shave your heads, and cut off your hair for the children of your delight. Enlarge your baldness like the vulture; for they have gone into captivity from you!
